## How it was tested

<!-- The commands you ran and what you checked by hand. -->

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run i18n` passes (where the repository has that script)
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests

## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change; anything non-trivial was agreed in an issue first
- [ ] Code, comments, commit messages and documentation are in English, and text people see is in the translation catalogs
- [ ] No new npm dependencies
- [ ] Anything I didn't write myself is named in the description, with its source, version and licence (one CONTRIBUTING.md accepts)
- [ ] If an AI assistant helped, the description says which one and for what, and I have read and tested every line

On your first pull request in this repository, the CLA bot asks every author of its commits to
sign the [Contributor License Agreement](https://github.com/cronumstudio/.github/blob/main/CLA.md)
with a comment. It asks once per repository; it is the same agreement everywhere.
